newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's November iron output falls 53.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Peru's November iron output falls 53.2 percent.

text.p: Peru's iron output fell 53.2 percent to 145,313 tonnes in November compared to the same month last year, according to preliminary figures from Energy and Mines Ministry released Friday.
Production fell 31.7 percent to 2.44 million tonnes in the first 11 months of the year against the same period last year.

Peru's only iron miner is Chinese-owned Shougang Hierro Peru SA, a former state-owned firm privatized in November 1992. Analysts say a series of strikes by Shougang workers earlier this year has affected production.
Total output of Peruvian iron dropped 14.33 percent last year to 3.897 million tons from 4.549 million tons in 1994.
